provenance.authoring: Original parametric editable geometry built for Vancouver Living Atlas. No downloaded meshes, photography, logos or artwork.

provenance.dimensionReference: TransLink BIDG2018 Figure 1.2.11 Nova typical bus; authorised 2026-10-11 correction

assets.dimensionBasis: Representative project proposal; no specific manufacturer measurement claim. Body nominal 12.4 x 2.5 m; Nova typical door positions, not a full brand replica; full exterior includes mirrors, lamps and roof equipment.

pivot.meaning: Tyre-contact datum at midpoint of front/rear axle centres

textureCost.note: Texture-free ordinary GLBs. Role IDs enable later shared material binding; no instance maps.

lodPolicy.stateRule: Keep exterior LOD0/1 and interior LOD0/1 loaded for any occupant, open door or boarding. LOD2 only closed, empty, nonboarding display.
lodPolicy.residentRule: Lazy-load interior for occupied or inspected buses only.

collision.note: Door proxies must animate with leaf transform; never use a solid body AABB for occupied state.

placementCompatibility.sourceRequirement: Consumer-selected road service transform and surveyed stop/walk-surface alignment. No fixed world XYZ.

runtimeChecks.reason: Offline package; WebGL integration and D06 boarding are not implemented here.

legacyToVehicleRoot.note: Datum conversion only from old local contact Y=.01 and axle midpoint Z=-.025. This newly proportioned model is not a vertexwise legacy mapping. Remove old runtime ground+1.08 offset.
